closureRules: VisitOSLO commercial services, rentals, ski schools, coaching products, routes, events and ticket products do not become canonical places merely because they appear on the attractions page.
Stable sub-attractions inside an existing broader place resolve to the parent unless they have an independently documented persistent institution/place identity.
The Ski Museum qualifies as its own canonical place because it is a persistent museum institution with its own collections, visitor identity and history inside the broader arena complex.
The jump tower does not get a separate new marker because it is already part of holmenkollen_nasjonalanlegg.
Oslo Golfklubb Bogstad was produced concurrently and is treated as existing canonical in the final current-main closure.
Kongeveien 5 is the locked canonical museum visitor marker; Kongeveien 40 remains a documented alternate access/complex address in coordinate evidence.
